title: Frontier 超級電腦架構
subcategoryTitle: 高效能運算與世界級超算
summary: 以Frontier 異質節點、HBM 與通訊拓撲串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect frontier heterogeneous nodes, hbm and interconnect topology with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 任務與節點
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「任務與節點」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop workloads and nodes through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 異質角色：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「異質角色」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for heterogeneous roles.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「異質角色」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：Frontier 計算節點結合 EPYC CPU 與 MI250X 加速器。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「依官方圖概念重畫自己的功能關係。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for heterogeneous roles. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Frontier compute nodes combine EPYC CPUs and MI250X accelerators. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Redraw original functional relationships from official descriptions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 依官方圖概念重畫自己的功能關係。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Redraw original functional relationships from official descriptions. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Frontier 每節點只有單一 CPU 運算。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Frontier nodes compute only on one CPU type. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「異質角色」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「依官方圖概念重畫自己的功能關係。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for heterogeneous roles; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: Frontier 計算節點結合 EPYC CPU 與 MI250X 加速器。
knowledge.textEn: Frontier compute nodes combine EPYC CPUs and MI250X accelerators.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 依官方圖概念重畫自己的功能關係。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Redraw original functional relationships from official descriptions. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 kernel 運算強度 I=2 FLOP/byte，持續記憶體頻寬 B=1 TB/s、峰值 P=20 TFLOP/s，則 roofline 上界 min(P,BI)=2 TFLOP/s。I=30 時上界20；這些不是 Frontier 實測值，精度、資料路徑與持續頻寬須另量。
knowledge.textEn: An assumed kernel with intensity 2 FLOP/byte, sustained bandwidth 1 TB/s and peak 20 TFLOP/s has roofline bound 2 TFLOP/s; intensity 30 is bounded by 20. These are not Frontier measurements; precision and data paths must be stated.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Frontier 超級電腦架構」的「異質角色：原理與架構」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Heterogeneous roles: principles and architecture” in “Frontier supercomputer architecture”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「異質角色」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for heterogeneous roles?
options: Frontier 每節點只有單一 CPU 運算。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「異質角色」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
Frontier 計算節點結合 EPYC CPU 與 MI250X 加速器。
optionsEn: Frontier nodes compute only on one CPU type.
One matching output proves heterogeneous roles for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Frontier compute nodes combine EPYC CPUs and MI250X accelerators.
quiz.explanation: Frontier 計算節點結合 EPYC CPU 與 MI250X 加速器。 依官方圖概念重畫自己的功能關係。 因此「Frontier 每節點只有單一 CPU 運算。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Frontier compute nodes combine EPYC CPUs and MI250X accelerators. Redraw original functional relationships from official descriptions. The alternative "Frontier nodes compute only on one CPU type." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 異質角色：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「異質角色」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for heterogeneous roles.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「依官方圖概念重畫自己的功能關係。」；將結果與「Frontier 計算節點結合 EPYC CPU 與 MI250X 加速器。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Redraw original functional relationships from official descriptions. Compare results against: Frontier compute nodes combine EPYC CPUs and MI250X accelerators. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 依官方圖概念重畫自己的功能關係。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Redraw original functional relationships from official descriptions. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Frontier 每節點只有單一 CPU 運算。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Frontier nodes compute only on one CPU type. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「異質角色」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「Frontier 每節點只有單一 CPU 運算。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for heterogeneous roles; explain why this claim fails: Frontier nodes compute only on one CPU type.

steps.titleEn: Logical GPU units: principles and architecture

Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Distinguish packages, GCDs and ranks for a toy task. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 區分假想任務的封裝、GCD 與 rank。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish packages, GCDs and ranks for a toy task. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.check: 提交「邏輯 GPU」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「區分假想任務的封裝、GCD 與 rank。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for logical gpu units; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.textEn: CPUs prepare, launch and handle some serial work.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 畫玩具迭代的 CPU/GPU 責任邊界。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Map CPU/GPU responsibilities in a toy iteration. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「CPU 管理」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for cpu orchestration?
options: CPU 處理準備、啟動與部分序列工作。
加入 GPU 就完全不需要 CPU 工作。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「CPU 管理」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: CPUs prepare, launch and handle some serial work.
Adding GPUs removes all CPU work.
One matching output proves cpu orchestration for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: CPU 處理準備、啟動與部分序列工作。 畫玩具迭代的 CPU/GPU 責任邊界。 因此「加入 GPU 就完全不需要 CPU 工作。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: CPUs prepare, launch and handle some serial work. Map CPU/GPU responsibilities in a toy iteration. The alternative "Adding GPUs removes all CPU work." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: CPU 管理：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「CPU 管理」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for cpu orchestration.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「畫玩具迭代的 CPU/GPU 責任邊界。」；將結果與「CPU 處理準備、啟動與部分序列工作。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Map CPU/GPU responsibilities in a toy iteration. Compare results against: CPUs prepare, launch and handle some serial work. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 畫玩具迭代的 CPU/GPU 責任邊界。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Map CPU/GPU responsibilities in a toy iteration. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：加入 GPU 就完全不需要 CPU 工作。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Adding GPUs removes all CPU work. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「CPU 管理」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「加入 GPU 就完全不需要 CPU 工作。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for cpu orchestration; explain why this claim fails: Adding GPUs removes all CPU work.

quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for cpu orchestration?
options: 加入 GPU 就完全不需要 CPU 工作。
畫玩具迭代的 CPU/GPU 責任邊界。
先把「CPU 管理」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。

Tune the displayed cpu orchestration result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.

steps.title: HBM 層次：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「HBM 層次」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for hbm hierarchy.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「HBM 層次」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：加速器近端 HBM 與主機記憶體有不同路徑。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「標註玩具陣列在主機與裝置的所在地。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for hbm hierarchy. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Accelerator HBM and host memory have different access paths. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark host and device placement of toy arrays. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 標註玩具陣列在主機與裝置的所在地。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Mark host and device placement of toy arrays. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：主機指標總可無成本當本地 HBM 使用。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Host pointers always act as free local HBM. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「HBM 層次」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「標註玩具陣列在主機與裝置的所在地。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for hbm hierarchy; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
